get.summary: Read ESP32 metadata for a currently assigned Operations Manager kiosk.
get.description: Cache-Control: no-store. No MQTT password or HMAC is read or returned. canDownload describes role/scope and public deployment readiness, not secret-store completeness. Foreign/missing/ended installations return the same 404. Current role and assignment are rechecked on every request. Error responses have a stable code extension.

get.summary: Read ESP32 metadata for the assigned Technician's live installation (SCHEDULED, INSTALLING, AWAITING_HANDOVER).
get.description: Cache-Control: no-store. No MQTT password or HMAC is read or returned. canDownload describes role/scope and public deployment readiness, not secret-store completeness. Foreign/missing/ended installations return the same 404. Current role and assignment are rechecked on every request. Error responses have a stable code extension.

get.summary: Admin oversight metadata only. Admin cannot download ESP32 secrets.
get.description: Cache-Control: no-store. No MQTT password or HMAC is read or returned. canDownload describes role/scope and public deployment readiness, not secret-store completeness. Foreign/missing/ended installations return the same 404. Current role and assignment are rechecked on every request. Error responses have a stable code extension.

post.summary: Download the assigned kiosk's config.local.h after verifying the current Operations Manager password.
post.description: JSON body {password}: current account password, verified for this download only. Returns attachment config.local.h, Cache-Control: no-store; Wi-Fi fields are blank. Admin/other roles: 403. Foreign/missing/ended installation: 404. Wrong/missing password: 401 ESP32_CONFIG_REAUTHENTICATION_FAILED. 409 codes: ESP32_CONFIG_DEPLOYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED, ESP32_CONFIG_NOT_PROVISIONED, ESP32_CONFIG_HMAC_MISMATCH. No secret values are included in errors or audit payloads.

200.description: Private config.local.h attachment; fill in local Wi-Fi before flashing.

post.summary: Queue or retry ESP32 provisioning for the currently assigned kiosk/installation
post.description: No request body or secrets. Current Manager/assigned live Technician only. New enrollment queues automatically when enabled. Retry keeps the original device credentials; READY/in-flight work is not reset. Poll the existing esp32-config GET. No heartbeat or ONLINE status is fabricated.
